rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: RE-FIRE target: chunk 4 "How we work in this room", line 24: "**Make it work for you.** Start from the moves this training teaches, then find your optimal way of working in your system." "the moves this training teaches" now names its own referent ("this training") inside the same clause — it is a forward-general reference to the whole training's content, not a pointer at a specific unnamed earlier slide. Prior flag ("the same moves" with no antecedent) is resolved. Closest-to-violating line otherwise: chunk 2 "Prework" line 10, "the repo you picked" — resolves against the student's own prework action per the maintainer's own accept-note at line 92 ("the section states what the prework left them holding"), matching the session-artifact carve-out in spirit even though this is a module file, not an exercise. Chunk 10 "Next" line 86, "Your rules file" resolves to `./CLAUDE.local.md` named at chunk 3 line 20 and chunk 7 line 61, same-file reuse, not a violation.

No chunk opens by pointing at prior slides or another file by position. Chunk 6 "Start here" and chunk 9 "Pre-reads before Module 2" link out to other files but name each by title/claim ("Painting the picture with the LLM", "The agentic engineering progression"), not by position.

Each header is a true summary of its chunk's content under sequential read: "Key Concepts" (line 56) is followed only by the loop, /context, self-report-vs-ground-truth, tests, CLAUDE.local.md, tracker-close bullets — no contradiction. "Optional challenges" (line 64) followed only by opt-in side-quest bullets.

Checked all five sub-items against every chunk: no "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triple; no self-grading superlative (grepped for "one of the most", "most useful" etc. — zero hits in body); no number-with-own-retraction pattern; no abstraction-noun stack ("the bounded-window reality"-style) or empty-leg verb triplet.
